scope: Spline electron DC fiducial loose, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/dcfid_el/loose/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Loose and tight stored fits for (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) are identical and pinned at B=-0.045000, chi-squared 44.679, NDF 13. Every TH1D in the two source files has the same bin contents, including this histogram: integral 380955.906 and max absolute content difference 0. The files differ in the stored source-path string, not in the histogram. The shared pinned value is not two different histograms agreeing. The manual (1, 8) window is B in [-0.05, 0.05] and C in [0, 0.1]. Pass 1 moved B only to -0.061293, collapsed C to 0, and lowered chi-squared only to 43.496. That is the second-pass window around the -0.05 edge. The old refine_init key asks for B_initial -0.061293 with limits [-0.03, 0.05], which excludes both that start and this histogram's cosine. The cosine on this histogram is B=-0.125176, C=-0.044544, chi-squared 39.259. Pass 2 put 49 starts on each histogram's own cosine, opened only the limits that excluded it, and turned off the half-width second pass when the amplitude is below 0.05. It refit Q2-y 1-16. Q2-y 17 had no new keys. Its largest chi-squared change from the stored fit is 1.7e-6. A third pass opened only (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_10), where C was stuck at 0 with an error of 2e-9 while the cosine is C=-0.00615. That chi-squared went from 31.725 to 31.303 and the C error is now 0.01347. (1, 8) stayed at B=-0.125177, statistical error 0.034681, C=-0.044544, error 0.031907, chi-squared 39.259, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. JSON still has 452 bins. 33 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is worse (largest increase 0.000618).
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved onto the nominal value. (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_3) stays at B=-0.19897 versus nominal -0.15443. (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_3) stays at B=-0.17185 versus nominal -0.13868. (Q2_y_Bin_7)-(z_pT_Bin_35) stays at B=-0.26425 versus nominal -0.24532. (Q2_y_Bin_17)-(z_pT_Bin_2) remains about 0.40 above its free cosine, inside the B statistical error, and was not given a new key. Excluded sector pairs were not put back into this comparison. No comparison was filled with zero. The source was not removed from the budget, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.

why_retained: The corrected guide is kept because every histogram is at least as good as the stored fit and 33 are better. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) follows this histogram's cosine, chi-squared 44.679 to 39.259, rather than the pinned B=-0.045 or a forced copy of the nominal. Loose and tight stay equal after the refit because their histograms are equal. The large shifts that were already the cosine were left where they are. Fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
